unit: one frozen E1 prediction per eligible fit claim

target.name: y_error
target.definition: 0 if frozen E1 predicted_claim_label equals authentic SUPPORT/CONTRADICT label; 1 otherwise, including NO_RELATION

features.name: decision_confidence
features.definition: For SUPPORT/CONTRADICT, probability of the exact winning sentence/class used by frozen aggregation. For NO_RELATION, minimum neutral probability over all 15 pairs because the decision is the conjunction that every pair is neutral-argmax.
features.failure_mechanism: weak confidence in the exact final decision

features.name: support_contradict_margin
features.definition: absolute(max over pairs entailment probability - max over pairs contradiction probability)

features.name: predicted_decision_category
features.definition: frozen E1 final category; fixed one-hot encoding with SUPPORT as reference, yielding is_CONTRADICT and is_NO_RELATION
features.no_relation: explicit is_NO_RELATION indicator; not relabelled as abstention or insufficiency

features.name: bm25_top2_normalized_margin
features.missing: forbidden because corpus always returns at least two documents

features.name: evidence_conflict_rate
features.definition: Let nS/nC count sentence pairs whose argmax is entailment/contradiction. If nS+nC=0 return 0; otherwise 2*min(nS,nC)/(nS+nC).
features.failure_mechanism: conflicting relations across retrieved evidence candidates
features.no_relation: 0 when every sentence pair is neutral-argmax
features.semantic_note: uses fixed NLI outputs across evidence candidates but never authentic evidence IDs or labels

preprocessing.standardization: training-fold mean and population standard deviation only; zero variance uses scale 1
preprocessing.categorical: fixed encoding defined by F3; no learned category order
preprocessing.imputation: none; nonfinite or missing inputs stop the affected run
preprocessing.correlation_rule: Before training, audit Pearson correlations without y_error. If abs(r)>=0.95, retain both only when they represent distinct preregistered mechanisms and L2 is used; flag coefficients as non-identifiable individually. No outcome-based pruning is permitted.
